text:
maria-partnerships: Quick heads up — Felipe (GCP partner) flagged a gating issue for the LATAM edge region we plan to light up next Friday. Marketplace listing and quota entitlements aren't approved yet.

felipe-gcp-partner: Correct — southamerica-west1 needs marketplace entitlement + project quota bump for GPUs. Partner portal shows 'Pending entitlement'. I opened ticket GCP-6421.

cj-ops: Can you paste the exact quota numbers we need? Also which SKU?

felipe-gcp-partner: Sure — we need 40 x a2-highgpu-1g (A100-equivalent) across two zones, and 200 vCPU reserved for burst. Portal ticket includes SKU IDs.

arjun-cloud-partner: Do we have a fallback plan if entitlements don't land? Can we route to hosted region (us-west1) with latency SLAs?

maria-partnerships: Fallback yes — route to hosted us-west1, but latency to Santiago is ~80ms vs target 40ms. Product wants canary in LATAM.

ana-partner-ops: (typo fix) @maria-partnerships -> @ana-partner-ops. Also confirming partner legal signoff is required for the marketplace listing.

lucy-legal: I need the marketplace T&Cs + partner MSA. Felipe, can you attach the doc links? If there are any customer data residency clauses for LATAM we need to review.

felipe-gcp-partner: Linking: https://partner-gcp.example.com/entitlements/GCP-6421 and marketplace draft https://gcp.marketplace/example/listing-draft (access granted to team). No extra residency clauses in the draft — standard data processing.

cj-ops: Ops checklist for capacity provisioning:
- submit quota request (ticket GCP-6421)
- partner entitlement approved in marketplace portal
- billing account linked + committed SKU
- infra team confirms node image (runtime-llm-v3) compatibility

arjun-cloud-partner: I'll take infra compatibility. @deploy-bot can you run a quick smoke deploy to a staging LATAM zone once quotas are ok?

deploy-bot: scheduled smoke deploy -> staging-southamerica-west1 at 2026-03-26T02:00Z (pending quotas).

maria-partnerships: Proposed timeline: today — legal review + quota escalation; +48h partner entitlements; +72h infra smoke; launch canary next Friday. Is that realistic?

felipe-gcp-partner: We can escalate to partner engineering now, but marketplace approval depends on GCP marketplace team response — usually 48-96h after legal signoff.

lucy-legal: I'll review the draft by EOD and flag any PII/residency items. If nothing pops up, mark as approved.

ana-partner-ops: I'll open an internal TG ticket to track approvals + owners: TG-1258. Adding CJ for infra, Lucy for legal, Felipe for partner.

cj-ops: If we need to hit the Friday canary, we should submit the quota escalation today with 'urgent: go-live' note. I'll do the submission and paste the request body here.

cj-ops: Request body:
```
{
  "project": "redwood-latam-edge",
  "region": "southamerica-west1",
  "skus": ["a2-highgpu-1g"],
  "count": 40,
  "vcpus": 200,
  "priority": "urgent-go-live"
}
```

felipe-gcp-partner: Confirmed — I'll follow up with GCP partner eng and loop in marketplace ops.

maria-partnerships: Great. Can everyone react with :white_check_mark: when their action item is done? I'll keep a running note in TG-1258 and ping if we slip. Thanks all.
